name: Aryanism
summary: Aryanism holds that an 'Aryan' race, narrowed by Nazi theorists to Nordic or Germanic peoples, is biologically superior, created human culture and is entitled to rule other races. It treats race mixing as the cause of civilizational decline, races as locked in a natural struggle, and the state as an instrument for preserving racial purity, with Jews cast as the chief enemy.
scope: Racial Aryanism as developed from Gobineau and Chamberlain through Nazi theorists (Gunther, Rosenberg, Hitler's Mein Kampf) and carried on by post-1945 neo-Nazis. Excludes the older philological meaning of 'Aryan' and the Indo-Aryan peoples, and Italian fascist 'Mediterranean' variants. Economic and religious questions are mostly unaddressed by the racial doctrine and answered low-confidence from Nazi practice.

keyFigures.name: Arthur de Gobineau
keyFigures.role: Author of the Essay on the Inequality of the Human Races, an early theorist of Aryan superiority.

keyFigures.name: Hans F. K. Gunther
keyFigures.role: Nazi-era racial theorist who ranked European subtypes with Nordics highest.

keyFigures.name: Adolf Hitler
keyFigures.role: Author of Mein Kampf and leader of the regime that applied Aryanism as state policy.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Nazi welfare was reserved for racially valued Volksgenossen, so care for the Aryan community is plausible, but it is not a stated doctrine and was denied to the 'unfit'.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Racial doctrine says nothing on wage levels; adherents (Nazi or neo-Nazi) split between worker-friendly and business-friendly lines.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Hitler treats the state as a racial organism rather than an economic mechanism, which subordinates markets to the race, though no market doctrine is stated.

public-ownership.rationale: Aryanism as a racial doctrine is indifferent to ownership; the Nazi regime kept private property under state direction rather than nationalizing broadly.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Not addressed by the racial doctrine; Nazi rhetoric attacked 'Jewish finance' but not wealth as such.

unions-good.rationale: Hitler attacks Marxism and its labor organizations as Jewish instruments, and independent unions were dissolved under Nazism.

property-fundamental.rationale: Property is conditional on membership of the racial community (Jews were expropriated), so it is not an overriding right; inferred.

regulate-corporations.rationale: No racial-doctrine position; the Nazi state directed business toward national-racial ends but adherents differ.

cut-welfare.rationale: Adherents favor support for the racially valued but cuts for the 'unfit'; the net answer is split and inferred.

worker-ownership.rationale: Collective worker ownership is a Marxist idea that Hitler attacks as Jewish-inspired; inferred.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Security-state powers against designated enemies fit the Nazi order, though not a racial-doctrine point.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Racial hygiene and purity ideals imply hostility to 'degeneracy' and drug use; inferred.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Adherents promote open racial hatred and see such restrictions as Jewish-influenced censorship; the Nazi regime itself restricted speech only against its enemies.

strong-leader.rationale: Hitler dismisses parliamentary mediocrity and puts personality and a leader first; Nazism rested on the Fuhrer principle.

state-harmful.rationale: Hitler describes the state as an essential biological instrument for preserving and advancing the race.

limit-guns.rationale: Nazi Germany disarmed disfavored groups while arming loyal Aryans; modern adherents typically oppose gun limits for themselves; inferred.

empower-police-military.rationale: Racial struggle, conquest and enforcement of racial laws required a strong military and police apparatus.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Racial and moral hygiene ideals imply hostility, though the Nazi regime tolerated regulated prostitution; inferred.

decide-locally.rationale: Racial unity under a central state and leader is the aim; Nazism centralized power in the Reich.

rehabilitation.rationale: Racial thought treats traits as inherited, undermining rehabilitation; inferred from the hereditarian outlook.

traditional-family.rationale: Nazi policy promoted the racially fit family as the reproductive base of the race, though Hitler's text excerpt says little on family.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Racial-reproductive ideals and Nazi persecution of homosexuals make adherents strongly opposed; inferred from policy.

abortion-legal.rationale: Nazi policy banned abortion for Aryan women while forcing it on others; population and race policy, not individual choice, governs.

more-religion-public.rationale: Adherents split between Christian, pagan and anti-Christian strands; Gobineau was Christian while Nazi leaders were mixed.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Adherents reject equal treatment of races and see race mixing and racial equality as harmful; Nazism institutionalized racial injustice.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Race and biology are treated as fixed and determining; gender views are not stated, so inferred.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Hitler argues racial purity is the precondition of cultural capacity and that Aryans created culture.

gradual-change.rationale: Nazism sought radical racial transformation rather than gradual change; not a doctrinal point of Aryanism itself.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Racial purity requires keeping non-Aryans out; neo-Nazi Western Imperium visions limit full citizenship to Aryans.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: The race-nation ordering and Nazi aggression rejected supranational limits on racial states.

free-trade.rationale: No racial doctrine on trade; Nazi autarky and Lebensraum thinking favored self-sufficiency, so inferred.

nation-first.rationale: Racial interest and survival come first; Nazism pursued conquest for Aryan Germans without regard for global cooperation.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Universal human-rights intervention contradicts racial hierarchy; adherents reject equal moral worth.

open-borders.rationale: Mixing between races is held to cause decline, so open borders contradict the core doctrine.

limit-growth.rationale: Lebensraum thinking demands growth in land and population for the race; environmental limits are not a stated theme.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Climate change is not addressed by the doctrine; inferred indifference.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Nazism combined technical pride with blood-and-soil mysticism; no clear doctrine.

revolution-justified.rationale: Nazism and its successors sought a radical racial revolution, though through legal seizure of power in Germany.

experts-over-public.rationale: Racial science claimed expert authority, but Nazism also rested on leader and instinct over technocracy.

central-planning.rationale: Hitler rejects the state as an economic mechanism, and Nazi economy kept private ownership under direction; inferred.

socialized-markets.rationale: Worker or public ownership is not part of the doctrine and conflicts with its anti-Marxism; inferred.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Unaddressed; adherents split between hereditary-stock thinking and anti-capitalist rhetoric.

basic-income.rationale: Support for the community is tied to racial membership and service, not unconditional; inferred.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Nazi autarkic economics favored protection; not a point of racial doctrine.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The Nazi state directed the economy toward racial-national and military goals; inferred.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Blood-and-soil romanticism favored peasant farmers, but this is not core to Aryanism.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Marxist abolition of money is rejected as Jewish-inspired by Hitler's anti-Marxism.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Hitler attacks 'Jewish finance', but a position on central banks is not stated.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Nazi Germany replaced unions with state-run labor bodies, but this is regime practice rather than Aryan doctrine.

one-party-rule.rationale: Hitler's rejection of parliamentary democracy and the Nazi one-party state; neo-Nazi visions are also autocratic.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Gobineau was a Legitimist while Nazism was not monarchist; adherents are split.

democracy-best.rationale: Hitler dismisses parliamentary democracy as weak and mediocre; Gobineau opposed democracy.

direct-votes.rationale: Hitler favors personality and leadership over mass voting; plebiscites were used by the regime for acclamation only.

workers-councils.rationale: Council power is a Marxist idea that Hitler denounces.

right-to-secede.rationale: Racial nationalism centers on a unified racial state, though secession by Aryans from multiracial states is welcomed; inferred.

natural-rulers.rationale: Core claim: the Aryan race is a superior group entitled to rule other peoples.

political-violence-never.rationale: Hitler presents struggle as natural law and rejects pacifism; Nazism used violence at scale.

war-builds-character.rationale: Struggle selects the strong in Hitler's account, and Nazi theory held war between races was destined.

separate-church-state.rationale: Adherents divide between Christian, pagan and secular strands and no doctrine is stated.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Racial and state authority rather than scripture shapes law, though Gobineau treated the Bible as historical; inferred.

private-courts-defense.rationale: The state is the instrument preserving the race, so privatizing defense runs against the doctrine.

military-superiority.rationale: Racial struggle and Lebensraum required dominant military force.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Hitler's goal is a German state of the German nation, with the state preserving a racial group.

class-struggle-history.rationale: History is driven by race and racial struggle, not class; Hitler rejects Marxism.

equal-outcomes.rationale: The doctrine asserts natural inequality of races and persons; Gobineau's essay rejects equality.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Land belongs to the dominant race in Lebensraum thinking; authority for non-Aryan peoples is not recognised.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Reparations to non-Aryan peoples contradict the racial hierarchy; inferred.

civilizational-union.rationale: Aryanism extends to a shared race across nations; neo-Nazi visions of a Western Imperium unite Aryan peoples.

self-interest-moral.rationale: The Nazi ethos subordinates the individual to the racial community.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Race and nation come before the individual in Nazi theory; Hitler treats the state as serving the race.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Blood-and-soil thought romanticizes nature, but this is not core to Aryanism.

limit-population.rationale: Pro-natalism for the Aryan race and Lebensraum expansion; limits apply only to the 'unfit'.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Nazism embraced industry and technology while romanticizing the rural; inferred.

accelerate-technology.rationale: The racial doctrine takes no stated position on the pace of technological change.

human-enhancement.rationale: Racial purity ideals favor eugenic breeding over technological modification; inferred.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Anachronistic; personal leadership is the ideal.

restore-past-order.rationale: Nazism claimed to renew the race rather than restore the past, while Gobineau lamented decline; split.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Doctrine of race and worldview takes precedence over pragmatism; inferred.

direct-action.rationale: Nazi movement used street violence alongside elections, but this is not core to Aryanism.

means-match-ends.rationale: Nazism used violence and coercion to build a racial order; inferred.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Aryan culture-founding is seen as civilizational achievement, hence not a return to foraging.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not part of the doctrine; a stratified order is assumed.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Distribution is by racial membership and service; need-based egalitarianism is rejected as Marxist.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Hitler blames Jewish finance rather than owners as such; the Marxist exploitation theory is rejected.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Marxism is a central enemy in Hitler's account.

collective-farming.rationale: Collectivization is Marxist; blood-and-soil favored the independent peasant.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: War flows from racial struggle in this view, not capitalism.

taxation-theft.rationale: Not a stated position; the Nazi state taxed heavily for racial-national ends.

harm-principle.rationale: The state may restrict individuals for racial purposes, as the Nuremberg-era regime did.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Rights depend on racial membership; the Nazi regime stripped Jews of citizenship.

conscription.rationale: Struggle and military superiority imply universal service; Nazi Germany reintroduced conscription.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Anti-democratic racial state; exit as a check contradicts the doctrine.

state-as-business.rationale: Hitler says the state is not an economic mechanism but a racial organism.

positive-liberty.rationale: Debates about the meaning of freedom are not addressed by the racial doctrine.

media-academia-power.rationale: Hitler blames Jews controlling the press; modern adherents extend such claims, though the academia part is inferred.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Core claim of race theory: ability and culture differ by race through blood.

organic-representation.rationale: Hitler favors a racial community and leader over parties; not a stated corporatist plan in sources.

total-state.rationale: Nazism subjected culture, education and economy to racial aims; the state serves the race.

national-rebirth.rationale: Gobineau's decline narrative and Nazi rhetoric of racial renewal; Hitler cites decay by blood poisoning.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Lebensraum and Generalplan Ost expanded territory for Aryans.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Nazi loyalty oaths to the leader fit, but feudal lord-follower rule is not Aryanism.

bound-labor.rationale: Blood-and-soil favored hereditary farms, but legal bondage is not a stated aim; neo-Nazi visions plan helots for non-Aryans.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Nazi ideologues rejected 'Jewish' universalism in science for 'Aryan science', but this is not stated generally.

universal-morality.rationale: The doctrine rejects universal equality; morals are racially grounded.

single-common-good.rationale: The racial community's good is paramount, with little interest-balancing; inferred.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Aryanism is violently antisemitic; Hitler sees Jews as parasites and lacking culture.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Return is limited to racial kin, so racially defined; inferred.

revive-national-language.rationale: Language revival is not addressed by the racial doctrine and adherents have no common view.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Democracy and worker councils are rejected in favor of the leader principle.

economic-freedom.rationale: Hitler places racial and state power ahead of economic liberty; inferred.

rule-by-example.rationale: Nazi rule rested on law, force and propaganda, not example.

national-self-determination.rationale: Each Aryan nation may rule itself, but not other peoples; the claim is racially bounded.

force-without-un.rationale: Nazi Germany used force for racial aims; supranational approval is rejected.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Mixed: race science claims reason, but Hitler stresses instinct, blood and will.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Benefits are reserved for the racial community; Jews were stripped of citizenship.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Nazi policy treated the 'work-shy' harshly; inferred.

class-collaboration.rationale: Hitler rejects Marxist class struggle in favor of national-racial unity.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Aryan cultural achievement is central, so heritage is valued.

dominated-front.rationale: Not stated; other peoples are inferior, so alliances with them are not sought, though anti-Western Aryanist forms differ.

workers-nation.rationale: Hitler rejects the international class and wants workers inside a national-racial community.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Nazi ideology assigned women a reproductive role in the racial state; Hitler's racial program puts the race's continuity first.

ban-interest.rationale: Hitler attacks Jewish finance, but a legal ban on interest was not a doctrinal demand in sources read.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The Nuremberg Laws banned race mixing and removed Jews' citizenship; neo-Nazi visions limit full citizenship to Aryans.

state-class-instrument.rationale: The Marxist account of the state is rejected; the state serves the race.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Energy sources are not addressed by the racial doctrine; adherents have no common view.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Aryanism denies non-Aryans can assimilate because race, not culture, defines belonging.

elite-replacement.rationale: Modern Aryanist currents hold that Jews and elites engineer racial dilution, matching Hitler's blood-poisoning claims.

proportional-representation.rationale: Parliamentary party systems are rejected; inferred.

national-mission.rationale: Aryans as culture-founders rule others but need not export a government form; inferred.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Nazism asserted natural gender roles rather than structural disadvantage; inferred.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Hitler denounces parliamentary politicians as weak and mediocre.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: The Nazi regime enforced sterilization and the T4 program for those deemed hereditarily unfit.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Violence by the racial state against its enemies is not seen as an offense; inferred.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Hitler's state actively shapes the race and nation.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Hitler blames race mixing for the decline of civilizations; Gobineau and Nuremberg-era law agree.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The doctrine ranks races, and Gobineau's essay rejects human equality.

socialism-one-country.rationale: A Marxist question; Aryanism rejects it, so the answer is inferred.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Nazism endorsed settlement and displacement in the east; calling it colonial and wrong runs against that, though it could simply be descriptive.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Law is differentiated by race under the Nuremberg regime; inferred.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Jewishness was defined by race, so conversion was irrelevant; no stated position.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Unaddressed; Nazi Germany had animal-protection laws but they were not a part of Aryanism.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: A Marxist debate about a socialist state; Aryanism rejects socialism and has no stated view.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Hitler rejects democratic legitimacy; Aryans are held entitled to rule others.

population-transfer.rationale: Nazism planned removal and murder of Eastern peoples for Lebensraum and forced Jewish emigration.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Hitler presents struggle as natural law; Nazi expansion relied on force.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Hitler sees struggle as natural law that selects the strong, and Nazi theory stressed racial war.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Nazis themselves were banned and later banned others; adherents are split and it is not a stated doctrine.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Racial rule over others is a core claim; republican freedom is not endorsed.

separated-powers.rationale: Nazi doctrine concentrates authority in the leader; Hitler scorns parliamentary checks.

vanguard-party.rationale: A Marxist concept; the Nazi party played a similar role but the statement is about the working class.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Priority goes to the racially valued, not to the poor; inferred.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Housing tenure is not addressed by the racial doctrine; adherents have no common view.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Strikes were banned under Nazi rule, though this is not Aryan doctrine.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Lebensraum arguments tie poverty to land shortage, but not to population as such; split.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Mixing between races is held to cause decline; unity requires racial purity.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Selection of rulers by race and leadership, not chance.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: The Nazi regime suspended protections to defeat internal enemies; inferred as acceptable to adherents.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Nazi Germany fixed prices, but price control is not a point of racial doctrine and adherents differ.

party-controls-media.rationale: Nazi Germany controlled the press, and Hitler blames Jewish control of the press as the reason.

party-commands-army.rationale: Nazism subordinated the army to party and leader; not a doctrinal point of Aryanism.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Citizenship by blood makes a wait irrelevant; adherents reject naturalization for non-Aryans altogether.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Pay of representatives is not addressed by the racial doctrine; adherents have no common view.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Nazi party discipline was strong, but not a doctrine of Aryanism.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Pooling among Aryan peoples may be welcomed by some pan-Aryan currents, but the EU as such is opposed; split inferred.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Hitler held supreme command and the leader principle places the forces under the leader.

clerical-rule.rationale: Racial leadership, not clergy, rules; Nazi rejection of clerical politics.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Hitler treats Marxist defeatism as treason and national struggle as natural.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Nazi Germany censored 'degenerate' art and Hitler ties culture to racial purity.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: A leader with no term limit fits the Fuhrer principle; inferred.

recall-officials.rationale: Authority flows from the leader rather than voters; inferred.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Alliances for conquest were pursued; neither isolation nor alliance is doctrine.

people-in-arms.rationale: Nazism favored a mass military and party militias but not abolition of a professional army.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Blood-and-soil romanticized the peasant as racial stock; inferred from Nazi thought.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Nazism sought to unite all Germans in one Reich, as its expansion into Austria and the Sudetenland shows.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Anti-intellectual strands exist, though race science claimed academic authority; inferred.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: The doctrine ranks races and claims only Aryans create culture.

death-penalty.rationale: The Nazi state used capital punishment extensively against enemies.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Gender equality is rejected, though racial-biology instruction was compulsory; inferred.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Race science relied on Darwinian struggle language; Gobineau used the Bible but this is not Aryanism proper.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Racial hygiene and moral order imply restriction; inferred.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Nazi citizenship law rested on German or related blood.

minority-language-support.rationale: Racial nation-state offers no support to non-Aryan minorities.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Minorities are defined by race and denied special status; inferred.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: The individual is subordinated to the racial community.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Hitler attacks Jewish finance, but cancellation is not a stated doctrine.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: The link between independence and economic structure is not addressed by the racial doctrine.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Racial state priorities override freedoms; inferred.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Equal moral worth is rejected, so duties to the world's poor are not recognised.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Self-reliant military power fits racial-national struggle; anachronistic.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Hitler rejects parliamentary rule but plebiscitary acclamation fits; no stated doctrine.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Central bank design is not addressed by the racial doctrine; adherents have no common view.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Territory is for the racial community; inferred.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Property is conditional on membership and service to the racial community, as Jewish property was seized.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Hitler attacks Bolshevism as Jewish; the state-capitalist label is a Marxist-internal debate.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Racial doctrine is silent on environmental regulation and adherents have taken both technocratic and nature-romantic lines; inferred as split.

collective-defense.rationale: A racial state pursuing its own expansion treats alliances as tools; Nazi practice was opportunistic, so binding mutual defence is inferred to be unwelcome.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Lebensraum policy treated conquest and annexation as legitimate for the racially superior nation; inferred from that practice.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: The Nazi state sought to bring churches under its control and place the race above religion; inferred from practice, with some neo-Nazi variants being religious.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: The Nazi model made the leader the embodiment of the racial community and abolished parties, not a neutral figurehead.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: The state as the organism of one people would defend its unity by force; inferred.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Mein Kampf wants a centralised racial state rather than regions with their own systems; inferred.

sacred-ruler.rationale: The Nazi leader cult stressed providence and the race rather than divine descent, and Hitler rejected hereditary monarchy; inferred.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Racial doctrine does not address tax rates; Nazi fiscal policy was not flat, so this is a weak inference.

character-from-environment.rationale: Aryanism holds that race determines character and ability, so environment cannot alter them.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The leader principle placed the Führer's will above statute, and Mein Kampf rejects constraint by parliamentary law.

space-expansion.rationale: Expansion was conceived as land in Europe (Lebensraum), not space; adherents split, so this is inferred.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Mein Kampf rejects democracy and divided power in favour of rule by a leader embodying the racial elite.

leader-cult.rationale: The Führer cult of portraits, mass rallies and praise as embodiment of the nation was central to Nazi practice and doctrine.

equal-parenting.rationale: Nazi family policy assigned women a racial-reproductive role; a court presumption of equal time is inferred to be unwelcome.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Nazi doctrine replaced class struggle with racial struggle and attacked Marxism as a Jewish creation.

land-redistribution.rationale: Nazi policy stressed blood-and-soil peasant holdings and conquest of land abroad rather than breaking up estates at home; inferred.

refugee-return.rationale: Racial doctrine expelled or killed peoples it deemed alien, so return rights are not supported; inferred from Nazi practice.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Hitler demanded union of all Germans and Lebensraum, and Nazi Germany annexed Austria and the Sudetenland on national grounds.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: The racial doctrine is mostly indifferent to religious belief, and no source documents punishment for apostasy; inferred.

women-must-cover.rationale: Racial doctrine addresses no dress code for women, and Nazi practice imposed none; inferred.

common-currency.rationale: Nazi nationalism rejected supranational economic arrangements, and a common currency is not a stated aim; inferred.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Racial doctrine favoured union of Germanic and Nordic peoples across borders as racial kin.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: The racial hierarchy denied inferior races any self-governing institutions in the state.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Adherents wanted minorities, especially Jews, out of the nation; whether by emigration to a homeland or not is not settled by doctrine.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Hitler explains history by race and blood and treats ideas and economics as secondary.

ban-cartels.rationale: Nazi Germany organised industry into compulsory cartels, so breaking them up was not a goal; inferred.

no-bailouts.rationale: The racial doctrine says nothing on bailouts, and Nazi and neo-Nazi adherents lean different ways.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: The Nazi state ruled on the claimed will of the racial community and rejected liberal constraints on it; inferred.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Nazi ideology assigned women a mainly domestic and maternal role, so parity in public bodies was rejected.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Nazi autarky aimed at economic independence backed by conquest of living space; inferred from that record.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Nazi doctrine opposes binding international standards and treats foreign conditions as interference; inferred.

moral-incentives.rationale: Nazi rhetoric placed common good before self-interest and sacrifice for the racial community; inferred.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Hitler's movement staged a putsch and prized struggle and force as a creator of political change; inferred.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Aryanism claims a racial aristocracy by blood, but Nazism did not make titled aristocracy central; inferred from the stress on hereditary racial rank.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Nazi education put race and the Germanic past at the centre of history teaching.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Aryanists justify rule by racial superiority and entitlement, not by uplifting the ruled; Hitler rejects raising lower races (inferred).

patriotic-education.rationale: Nazi schooling demanded loyalty to the nation and race and to its symbols.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Adherents oppose preferences for minorities but also reject race-blind judgement, since they favour race-conscious policy for Aryans; split.

public-money-creation.rationale: Nazi writers attacked finance and interest, so public control of money is plausible, though not a core racial doctrine (inferred).

capitalism-adapts.rationale: The racial doctrine does not address capitalist crises; adherents are split (inferred).

former-empire-influence.rationale: Nazi practice sought dominion over lands held to be Germanic or Aryan in the past (inferred).

delink-world-market.rationale: The doctrine is about race, not development strategy, and does not address poor-country trade (inferred).

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Aryanists reject class solidarity and favour racial hierarchy, but do not use a labour-aristocracy account either (inferred).

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Nazi practice mandated discrimination by the state and neo-Nazis claim freedom to discriminate; the property-rights framing is inferred.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Nazi rule suspended civil rights and put the racial community above individual rights.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Treaties are not addressed by the racial doctrine; adherents would reject treaties favouring other races but not on principle.

elective-rulers.rationale: Nazi doctrine put authority in a racial leader (the Fuhrerprinzip) rather than in elections, though it was not monarchist; inferred.

minority-veto.rationale: Hitler rejected majority rule and the equality of persons but equally rejected any individual veto; the leader decides, so a minority veto is inconsistent.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Nazi doctrine put the leader above law as the embodiment of the racial community, so a right to resist him is rejected; inferred.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Mein Kampf rejects parliamentary democracy and majority rule in favour of leader authority.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Hitler held that Aryans may use and dominate lower creatures and races; animal protection was not central, though Nazi Germany passed animal-welfare laws, so adherents differ.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Humans, and the Aryan above all, were seen as entitled to use animals; Nazi law regulated cruelty, so humane use is inferred.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Nazi welfare duties were owed only to racially valued members of the community; the aristocratic idea of duty was not stated doctrine.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Aryanism demands that members of the racial community fight and serve the nation, so withdrawal from public life is rejected.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Nazi propaganda treated mass culture as a tool to shape opinion, though adherents see it as theirs to use rather than a hidden pacifier; inferred.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Adherents regard power as won by will and propaganda and force alike; the hegemony thesis is not part of the doctrine.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Aryanism explains global inequality by race rather than structure and treats exploitation as the natural right of the strong; inferred.

native-born-offices.rationale: Nazi doctrine tied citizenship and public office to racial membership, and the Nuremberg Laws restricted both to those of German blood.

party-own-road.rationale: Not applicable to the doctrine; communism was held as the enemy, so the question is not addressed.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Nazi economic ideas stressed autarky and national self-sufficiency; inferred from Lebensraum and autarky policy.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Revanchism over territory lost after 1918 and a Greater Germany were central aims of Nazi policy.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: The doctrine holds Aryans as the natural rulers over other races, so rule by non-Aryan descendants is rejected.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Aryanism is the racial core of fascism and Nazism; anti-fascism as a founding value is the opposite of its aims.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Aryanists reject the equation of Nazism with communism and regard Marxism as a Jewish product.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Neo-Nazi and Confederate-sympathetic adherents tend to deny slavery as the main cause, though the doctrine is not directly about the Civil War; inferred.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Adherents defend monuments to figures of the racial tradition and oppose their removal; inferred.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Not addressed; Nazi doctrine gave men and women separate roles and valued male soldiers, but adherents do not take up the issue.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Not addressed in the racial doctrine; Nazi gender roles cast men as protectors but the issue was not stated.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Aryanism holds that institutions follow race, so other peoples would develop their own forms; inferred from the racial theory.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Nazi Germany used the army and the SS as instruments of the party and the racial state, but the Wehrmacht was meant to serve the leader; the guardian role was not doctrine.

paid-care-work.rationale: Nazi doctrine assigned women to the home and motherhood, and honoured motherhood but did not call for wages; inferred.

filial-duty.rationale: Racial doctrine stresses duty to the Volk and family as the carrier of the race; filial duty is inferred, not stated.

office-by-exam.rationale: Aryanism assigns rule by racial worth and the leader principle, not by examination; inferred from the doctrine.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: The doctrine treats the nation as a racial body to be shielded from foreign influence, so blocking foreign buyers is inferred.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Nazi policy promoted marriage and childbearing among the racially valued, so easy dissolution is inferred as disfavoured.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Mein Kampf rejects majority rule and parliamentary accountability in favour of leader authority.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: The racial doctrine says nothing on pensions; Nazi practice used state welfare for the racial community, so private accounts are inferred as disfavoured.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Blood-and-soil ideas tie land to the race, but this is not a communal land tenure doctrine; adherents are unspecific.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Hitler attacked parliaments and majority decision, so legislative control of spending is rejected.

single-official-language.rationale: Aryanism seeks a racially unified nation with one common culture, so a single state language is inferred.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: The doctrine reserves the nation and its soil for the racial community, so barring foreign land buyers is inferred.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Aryanism rests on a racial hierarchy and denies equality between races, so treating unequal outcomes as discrimination is rejected.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Nazi writers attacked materialism as corrupting the race; this is inferred rather than a stated doctrine.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Nazi Germany used subversion and support for outside movements against rivals; this is inferred, not part of the racial doctrine.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Racial struggle and Lebensraum imply domination of lesser states by the Aryan power, so force against an ally is inferred as acceptable.

corporate-influence.rationale: Nazi practice subordinated business to the racial state; inferred, as the racial doctrine does not address lobbying.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Nazi doctrine treats foreign influence as racial threat, so restricting foreign funding fits; inferred.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Nazi policy gave marriage loans and child bonuses to Aryan families to raise the birthrate.

residents-only-property.rationale: Racial exclusion from land and property fits the doctrine; local-residence limits are inferred, not stated.

job-guarantee.rationale: The Nazi regime ran work-creation programmes for Aryans, but the racial doctrine itself is silent on this.

democratic-peace.rationale: Aryanism holds that races are locked in natural struggle, so democracy and peace are rejected.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Mein Kampf demands obedience to the racial state and leader, so a general right to disobey is rejected; inferred.

non-intervention.rationale: Racial struggle and expansion are central, so a ban on intervention is rejected.

industrial-unions.rationale: Nazi labour policy replaced unions with the German Labour Front; inferred opposition to independent unions of any kind.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Aryanism casts Jews as the chief enemy secretly working against the nation and race.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Aryanism prizes marriage for racial reproduction, regulating it via the Nuremberg Laws, not abolishing it.

public-access-to-information.rationale: The Nazi state was secretive and denied public access to information; inferred.

local-production.rationale: Blood-and-soil rhetoric favoured peasant agriculture, but the doctrine is silent on local production in general.

informal-organisation.rationale: Aryanism demands a hierarchical, leader-led structure, opposing informal horizontal groups.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Hitler placed the racial state above international law and treaties.

religious-nation.rationale: Aryanism defines the nation by race, not religion; Hitler was wary of religious definitions.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Aryanism holds that a superior race is entitled to rule others, which implies subordinate peoples owe it deference; inferred.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: It imagines a unified racial state, so regions keeping their own revenue is not a concern; inferred.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Nazi racism kept private property for the racial community and rejected socialism; inferred.

defeat-communism.rationale: Nazi racial theory cast Bolshevism as a Jewish-led threat to be destroyed.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: The racial doctrine is indifferent to how public services are delivered; inferred.

religion-illusion.rationale: Hitler's racial writings treat religion as a tool of racial and national strength, not an illusion; inferred.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Nazi racism blamed Jewish finance capital while keeping private enterprise, so capitalism is not credited as progressive; inferred.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Nazi racial ideology confined women to motherhood and the home; inferred.

socialized-care.rationale: The racial state wanted women to raise children in the family; inferred.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Nazi cultural nationalism favoured purifying German of foreign influence; inferred.

treaties-binding.rationale: A racial hierarchy gives no binding force to treaties with subordinate peoples; inferred.

cooperative-communities.rationale: A racial hierarchy and leader-led state are opposed to egalitarian cooperative communes; inferred.

majority-settlement.rationale: Nazi racial policy promoted German settlement in the east for living space; inferred from its racial doctrine.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Nazism presented itself as a third course between capitalism and Marxism; inferred.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Inferred from Nazi blood-and-soil doctrine, which tied the Aryan race to its Nordic homeland and to Lebensraum, though not stated as a historic-claim principle.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Nazi doctrine did not deny but enacted the Holocaust; post-1945 neo-Nazis commonly deny it, though sources here do not discuss this, so this is inferred for the later strand.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Nazi practice persecuted homosexual men under Paragraph 175, and the racial state treated them as a threat to Aryan reproduction.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Mein Kampf rejects democracy and the Nazi state eliminated opposition parties and independent organisations to preserve racial unity.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Nazi doctrine was racial, not religious; sources say little on punishing blasphemy and adherents split between Christian, pagan and secular views.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Aryanism holds the Aryan race entitled to rule other races, and Lebensraum treated conquered lands as serving the master race.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Inferred: Islam is not part of the doctrine, and a duty of resistance for Muslims is outside its concerns.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Inferred: the doctrine places racial rule above religion and is silent on religious-law legitimacy.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Mein Kampf and Gobineau reject democracy and equality, and hold decisions rest with the racial elite under the leader.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: The doctrine holds that races are fixed and unequal and rejects the idea of overlapping oppressions needing joint remedy.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Racial doctrine sought to control reproduction and rejects recognition of gender nonconformity; inferred from Nazi practice.

assisted-dying.rationale: Nazi practice included the 'euthanasia' programme against the 'unfit', but for racially valued Aryans this is not stated as a right to choose; inferred.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Aryanism treats race as the basic division and sees left-right as a distraction, though Nazis claimed to transcend both; inferred.

alienated-labor.rationale: Inferred: Aryanism treats Marxism as a Jewish creation, and the sources state no view on alienated labor.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Inferred: Aryanism treats non-Aryan peoples as racially incompatible with European culture, but the sources do not discuss Islam.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Nazi doctrine invoked Providence, but authority was held to come from the race and the Fuhrer; adherents split between Christian, pagan and secular views.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: The racial doctrine says nothing on religious dress in state institutions.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Inferred from a regime that crushed independent unions and courts and favoured employer and state power over complainants.

social-market-economy.rationale: Nazi economics were state-directed and racial, not a social market model; inferred.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Struggle between races and the state's duty to preserve the race make disarmament contrary to the doctrine.

rich-first.rationale: Inferred: racial hierarchy gives permanent privilege to the master race, not step-by-step uplift of others.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Nazi Germany pursued alliances and expansion, and Mein Kampf favours alliances with chosen powers, so neutrality between blocs is not endorsed.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Nazi theory favoured the Fuhrer principle, with leadership chosen by racial and personal merit rather than inheritance; inferred from that practice.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Nazi rhetoric attacked 'interest slavery' and finance capital as Jewish, but the regime ran state-directed credit, not user-owned mutual banks; economics is mostly unaddressed by the racial doctrine.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Nazi doctrine stressed national autarky and defiance of foreign creditors and Versailles obligations; inferred from Nazi practice.

property-franchise.rationale: The racial doctrine makes blood, not property, the basis of citizenship and political rights, so a wealth qualification is not central.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Aryanism asserts hierarchy and natural struggle as good, and assigned women to a subordinate reproductive role.

reification.rationale: This is a Marxist analysis; Nazi theory rejected Marxism and explained social conflict in racial terms.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Nazi propaganda attacked the 'Jewish press' but wanted state-controlled media, not a critique of wealth as such; inferred.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: The Nazi legal order subordinated law to racial will and Fuhrer decrees and rejected equality before the law.

racial-franchise.rationale: Aryanism holds that only members of the racial community may be citizens with political rights, as in the Nuremberg Laws, and that the Aryan race should rule others.

online-participation.rationale: The doctrine rejects mass deliberative democracy in favour of leader rule; online forums are used by modern adherents but not endorsed as decision-making.

open-government-data.rationale: Authoritarian leader rule and racial secrecy are the model; inferred from Nazi practice.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Aryanism restricts marriage by race, not religion; Nazi law barred Jewish-German marriages on racial grounds, and Christian-based religious restriction was not a core demand.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: The Nazi boycott of Jewish shops in April 1933 was a signature early act of racial persecution, though the target was defined racially rather than religiously.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Inferred from the Nazi leader principle and racial-elite rule, which reject deliberation by ordinary citizens chosen by lot.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Inferred: the doctrine is racial rather than theological, and Nazi theorists broke with or replaced Christian teaching rather than reinterpreting it for modern conditions.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Nazi-era racial doctrine attacked 'Jewish' finance capital but protected Aryan property, so adherents are split; inferred from Nazi practice.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Nazi racial-hygiene policy persecuted homosexual men as threats to racial reproduction; inferred from that practice.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Nazi rule persecuted churches selectively but did not run a state atheism programme; inferred from practice, and racial doctrine itself is indifferent.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: The doctrine makes the state an instrument for enforcing racial purity, which requires police and prisons; inferred from that.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Racial hierarchy and the leader principle reject sharing executive power among communities; inferred from Mein Kampf's view of the racial state.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Nazi welfare was state-run for racial comrades and Mein Kampf stresses the state's duty to the race; inferred, not a stated position.

term-limits.rationale: Nazi doctrine favoured a leader without electoral limits; inferred from the leader principle.

vote-delegation.rationale: Aryanism rejects democratic participation in favour of leader authority; inferred from the Führerprinzip.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Existential risk as a policy theme is anachronistic; adherents prize racial survival but not humanity's in general.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Nazi ideology assigned women a separate domestic sphere; inferred from Nazi practice.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Nazi family doctrine held the husband as head of household; inferred from Nazi practice.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Nazi racial doctrine denied non-Aryans any political voice, and the foreign-born even less.

rent-control.rationale: Inferred from Nazi practice, which favoured private property for Aryans and showed no interest in tenant protections.

abolish-ip.rationale: Inferred from the claim that the Aryan race created culture and invention, which makes ownership of it a racial matter, not something to abolish.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Nazi practice built the Hitler Youth to train racially selected youth for national service.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Anachronistic; the racial doctrine does not address nuclear basing, so adherents have no settled view.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Inferred from the demand for racial and national self-rule free of outside control.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Nazi racism denied the genocide of Jews, and neo-Nazi successors do the same.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Inferred from Nazi rhetoric that set productive 'creative' labour against 'parasitic' capital, though the doctrine is racial first.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Mein Kampf treats struggle and the right of the stronger as natural law, so abstaining from force is condemned.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Mein Kampf and Gobineau trace a continuous racial inheritance from the original Aryan stock to the present nation.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Gobineau's racial science treats sex and race as fixed biological facts, not constructs.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Inferred from the biological determinism and fixed gender roles of Nazi racial doctrine.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Nazi practice built a cult of its dead as martyrs, and neo-Nazis keep up the memorials.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Mein Kampf frames history as a struggle between the Aryan and its enemy, often in near-religious language.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Inferred from the aim to gather all Germans or Aryans into the racial state, as in 'Heim ins Reich'.

culture-before-state.rationale: Inferred from the state as an instrument of racial preservation, which comes first; culture follows from race.

god-not-male.rationale: Inferred from the 'positive Christianity' and Germanic neo-pagan currents, which cast God as a male racial hero; not a stated doctrine.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Inferred from the doctrine's rigid, male-led gender roles.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Racial doctrine demands that economy and rule rest in Aryan hands and that Jews and other groups be excluded.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Inferred from pan-German aims such as the Anschluss, which merged German-speaking lands into one Reich.

independent-unions.rationale: Inferred: the Nazi state suppressed independent unions and replaced them with a state-controlled labour front, in line with the state as racial instrument.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Inferred: Aryanism rejects class struggle and Marxism in favour of racial community.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Not addressed by the racial doctrine; Nazi practice tolerated both public and private provision.

second-chamber.rationale: Inferred: Hitler's Mein Kampf rejects parliamentary institutions in favour of leader authority.

municipal-property.rationale: Inferred: Aryanism rejects Marxist socialisation and favours state direction of a racial community.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Inferred: authority is centralised under the leader and the state, not delegated to local assemblies.

family-wage.rationale: Inferred: Nazi pro-natalist policy aimed to support Aryan families.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: The sources never address this issue, and nothing in the core principles settles it, so it is left neutral at low confidence.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: The sources never address this issue, and nothing in the core principles settles it, so it is left neutral at low confidence.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Inferred: the racial state demands visibility and control of its subjects.

online-anonymity.rationale: Inferred: the racial state demands visibility and control of its subjects.

person-over-state.rationale: Hitler describes the state as a means to preserve the racial community, and individuals are subordinate to it.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Hitler rejects pure materialism in favour of idealism and race as a spiritual-biological force; inferred as a mild yes.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Inferred: the racial state is centralised, and Nazi Germany abolished the powers of the Lander.

gm-crops.rationale: Not addressed by the racial doctrine.

dense-cities.rationale: Inferred from the Blood and Soil ideal of the rural peasant as the source of racial strength.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Mein Kampf treats races as locked in natural struggle and urges the Aryan to organise to defend and advance his race.

racial-pride.rationale: Aryanism holds the Aryan race to be superior and its preservation to be a duty.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Mein Kampf calls for territorial expansion and conquest to secure living space for the race.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Hitler rejects language as the basis of nationhood and holds that blood and race, not speech, make a people.

communal-electorates.rationale: Inferred from the one-race, one-Volk state; separate religious communities voting apart contradicts it.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Nazi doctrine cast Germany as threatened by a Jewish world conspiracy and by hostile encirclement.

free-public-college.rationale: Inferred from the racial elitism and state control of education; Nazi practice restricted university access by race and politics.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Inferred from the absence of any environmental-tax idea in the racial doctrine, and a state-directed economy.

future-generations.rationale: Inferred from the duty to preserve racial stock for posterity, which is about heredity rather than a damaged Earth.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Inferred from Nazi gender roles, which cast women as mothers of the race and valued martial hardness over care or nonviolence.

arms-reduction.rationale: Racial struggle and conquest of living space are central; Mein Kampf treats armed strength as necessary and disarmament as weakness.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from Hitler's contempt for diplomacy by treaty and Nazi practice of secret pacts.

capital-controls.rationale: Inferred from Nazi practice, which imposed exchange and capital controls under state direction of the economy.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: The Nazi state disarmed opponents and 'unreliable' groups while the party's own armed formations served the regime, so a state-controlled armed monopoly under racial rule is the expected position.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Racial struggle and war are glorified and obedience is central, so refusing orders to fight is rejected.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Independent unions were abolished under Nazism in favour of a state labour front; inferred from that practice, not racial doctrine.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: The racial doctrine does not address income top-ups; Nazi welfare favoured racially valued families but no tax-credit position is documented.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Inferred from Nazi practice of deficit-financed rearmament and a leader-directed state unbound by legal limits.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Inferred: the doctrine ranks races by worth and seeks German racial dominance, not redistribution toward developing countries.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Aryanism wants the state captured and used as an instrument of racial preservation, not smashed; inferred from Mein Kampf's view of the state.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: A fixed racial order enforced by the state leaves no room for communities choosing their own systems.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Blood-and-soil themes value land, but pricing ecosystems as capital is not addressed; inferred and split.

sacred-nation.rationale: Mein Kampf treats the racial nation (Volk) as the bearer of culture whose preservation is the highest duty, outlasting its members.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Not addressed by the doctrine; inferred indifference.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Inferred: the doctrine sees the nation as a racial unity and focuses on external racial hierarchy rather than regional exploitation within a state.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Aryanism holds that races differ in biological worth and rejects a common human nature and equal dignity.

public-service-media.rationale: Nazi Germany used media as state propaganda under Goebbels, not as independent public service media.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Nazi theorists favoured a racially defined 'Aryan' or 'positive' Christianity or neopagan faith over universal religious truth; inferred from the racial doctrine, which makes spirit race-specific.

farm-price-support.rationale: Nazi 'blood and soil' ideology celebrated the racially pure peasantry and protected it with price supports and entailed farms; inferred from Nazi practice.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: A racial-struggle doctrine that treats power politics as natural would not favour disarming while rivals hold weapons; inferred, since nuclear arms are anachronistic for the doctrine.

workers-own-party.rationale: The racial state subordinates class to the national-racial community and Nazi rule suppressed independent labour parties; inferred from practice and the anti-democratic stance.

ban-fgm.rationale: Not addressed by the doctrine; adherents would likely condemn it as a practice of 'lower' races, though this is inferred.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Nazi inheritance law (Erbhof) passed farms to male heirs and the doctrine casts women chiefly as mothers of the race; inferred.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Pan-Germanic racial thinking treated Germanic peoples as one folk and one language family, so Dutch or Flemish would be dialects of one tongue; inferred.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: The racial state places the community above individual property claims and rejects liberal legal individualism, so private tort remedies are not favoured; inferred.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Hitler's Führer principle concentrates lawmaking in the state and racial leadership, leaving no place for customary chiefs; inferred.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Blood-and-soil thought treated protecting land as a racial duty and Nazi Germany passed nature-protection law over individual liberty; inferred.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: An authoritarian racial state favours fixed harsh punishment for 'asocial' repeat offenders over judicial discretion; inferred from Nazi practice.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Aryanists mainly want non-Aryans excluded rather than assimilated, so a language requirement is not a stated position; adherents are split.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Nazi practice replaced independent unions with a compulsory labour front; inferred from that record, not a stated doctrine.

voter-id.rationale: Inferred from the doctrine's tight racial definition of citizenship; voter ID itself is not discussed.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Nazi theorists favoured an 'Aryan' Christianity or neo-pagan faith over equal standing for others; inferred and contested.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Aryanism rejects democracy and equality in favour of rule by the racially superior and a leader principle, so procedure alone confers no legitimacy.

premarital-sex.rationale: Nazi practice mixed moral conservatism with pronatalism for racially valued women; adherents are split.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Inferred from the doctrine's view of the state as an instrument of racial preservation, which allows wide control; not documented.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Welfare was reserved for the racially valued under Nazi practice, so a universal cash payment is inferred as unwelcome.

women-suffrage.rationale: Nazi practice excluded women from political office and stressed a motherhood role; inferred from that record.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: The doctrine is racial and not centred on religion's effect on women; inferred from Nazi gender policy.

race-social-construct.rationale: Aryanism holds that races are distinct biological categories with inherited hierarchy, the opposite of this statement, as the sources set out.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Nazi practice rejected state promotion of gender equality in favour of separate roles; inferred from that record.

missingStatements.text: Some races are inherently superior to others and are entitled to rule them.
missingStatements.rationale: The core claim of Aryanism is that the Aryan race is superior and entitled to rule other peoples.

missingStatements.text: The mixing of races causes the decline of civilizations.
missingStatements.rationale: Gobineau and Hitler both attribute the fall of civilizations to racial mixing or blood poisoning.

missingStatements.text: Jews are a distinct race whose influence harms the nations they live among.
missingStatements.rationale: Hitler calls Jews a parasitic race and Nazi ideology treated them as the main threat to Aryans.
missingStatements.declined: Targets one specific group, which would only suit a few ideologies; the racial-hierarchy and race-mixing statements already capture the underlying racial doctrine.

notes: Gobineau himself wrote positively of Jews and saw decline as unavoidable, and Italian fascists used a Mediterranean version of 'Aryan'; neither matches the Nazi-era profile. Many non-racial questions (economy, religion) are unaddressed and answered from Nazi practice at low confidence.
